title: the proof of the table reads the state of a place, the liveness of a place and the coverage of a fan
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track A (the wave A3, the second repair): the check of wave 82 promised more than it proved, and the discriminator of the package of the waves 82 and 83 named nine findings, of which six touch the proof of the table (F9–F14).  The code of the kernel is honest; the proof is not.  The wave touches no code of the kernel.  (1) **The check of the cells could not fail at all** — the root cause of the false greens: the verdict stood inside a `dolist', and `dolist' returns nil, so the check of the cells answered 'yes' whatever the kernel said.  The verdict is out of the loop now, and the witness of a cell is read over **all** the places of its label and not over the first one.  (2) **The witness of a cell is a place the runtime runs** (F9): a place that only a name, a test or a script reaches is dead for the runtime, and a dead place witnesses nothing.  Death and silence are two different things: a **live** place that names no state witnesses a cell weakly, and that is a measurement and not a refusal.  (3) **The state of a place is read** (F9, F11): the state comes from the guard around the place and from the chain of the moves before it, and a state bound to a local variable is read as well.  (4) **A name is not a call** (F10): a quoted symbol and a function designator name a definition and do not call it; the name in the first argument of `funcall' and of `apply' is a call, because the runtime calls the value there.  (5) **A fan is judged only when the runtime states the whole coverage of it** (F13): the coverage of the fan `interrupt' is not stated at all, and the check names that fan instead of blaming the runtime.  (6) **The report names the numbers** (F14): the places that name no state, the labels that have no such place, and the fans whose coverage is stated in full.  The claim `every-transition-of-the-table-is-taken' keeps its id and is amended, not rewritten (the precedent is §16.28): the promise becomes exactly what the check proves, and the blind spots of the runtime are named in the promise and not hidden.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a run: the check is static on purpose, because there is no run that takes every move of the table -- a run that meets no busy provider never takes `rate-blocked', and a run that never grows long never takes `budget-overflow'.  The static check answers about the whole kernel at once, and it answers the same way twice.  The price is named and it is the same price as before, only counted better: **nine of the twenty-three places of the kernel name no state**, so **fifteen of the thirty-one cells** rest on the machine alone, and the check lists those places and those labels by their file and their line.  The fan `interrupt` has **no stated coverage**, and a fan is judged only when the runtime states the whole of it -- the runtime does not state it, and only the runtime can.  The liveness is static: a definition that is reached only through a computed value is dead for the check, and the check says so.  The chain of the moves is read statically: a state that the runtime computes by a call is not read, and such a place names no state.  The wave touches no code of the kernel: the table of the machine and the runtime are honest, and what was broken was the proof.
refuted_by: a cell of the table of the machine is not a move the machine makes, or a label of the table has no live place in the runtime where a run takes that move, or a live place takes the move of a cell from a state the cell does not lead from, or the runtime takes a move the machine does not have, or the runtime narrows a fan of the table whose coverage the runtime states in full, or a fan of the table does not end in one state, or a state of the machine is not reachable from the first one through the cells of the table, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `every-transition-of-the-table-is-taken' is the same, the text says that the witness of a cell is a place the runtime runs, that the state of a place is read from the guard and from the chain of the moves, that a place which names no state is named by the check, and that a fan is judged only when the runtime states the whole coverage of it -- the fan `interrupt', whose coverage the runtime does not state, is named in the promise; the `falsifier' names the new refusals, and the `control' is the same.  Fifteen controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- nine by the writer of the wave and six more by the parent, and the parent's six were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 3 seconds.  (2) The tick of `budget-ok' takes the move of `tool-end' (`lib/yeah-turn.el:880') -- «the runtime takes 3 move(s) the machine does not have»; code 1.  (3) The tick of `nudge' is moved into a definition that only a `defconst' names -- «1 cell(s) the runtime does not take: ((post-decide nudge . deciding) ...)»; code 1.  (4) The state of the place is bound to a local variable -- the same refusal and «the place stands in a state the machine has no move from»; code 1.  (5) The fan of `error' is narrowed -- «(error :the-runtime-narrows-the-fan (idle))»; code 1.  (6) A dead place -- the same refusal as (3); code 1.  (7) An exception inside the check -- «the check could not read the kernel: Wrong type argument: listp, 1»; code 1.  (8) The regression of D6 (the arguments of the form are read as `(cdr (cdr form)' again) -- the code 0, but the proof empties: **twenty-five** weak cells instead of fifteen; the number is not the number of the wave 82 (29) because the formulation of the weakness is another one, and the writer says so.  (9) The report prints the numbers and the named lists -- the code 0.  The parent's six: the honest tree (0); the tick of `user-prompt' moved from `idle' to `deciding' (1); the state of the place through a local variable (1); the tick of `nudge' in a definition that only a name reaches (1); the fan of `interrupt' narrowed (1); a move of the runtime that the machine does not have (1).  **The parent found the false green of (3) in the middle of the work** and named the cause -- the verdict of the cells stood inside the loop of the places, so a dead place that names no state counted as a weak witness -- and the writer fixed the rule of the witness, not the symptom.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 1102 lines and 51.4 kB (the wave 82 one was 793 lines and 35.7 kB), and it goes in 2.96 seconds; the table has thirty-one cells, seventeen labels and eleven states; the kernel has twenty-three places of a tick, and all of them are live for the runtime; fourteen of the twenty-three places name the state of the run and nine do not; eight of the seventeen labels have no place that names a state; fifteen of the thirty-one cells rest on a place that names no state; sixteen of the thirty-one cells are proven by the state of the place; one fan of the two has its coverage stated in full, and the other one -- `interrupt' -- does not, and the check says which is which.  The unit tests of the table pass (23/23), and the control of the claim itself gives the code 1 with three findings -- its `sed' changes two cells of the table.
